0: The seed for biome v6 — the touchstone from which a fresh mind holding only the one function regenerates the whole biome, and the battery by which that regeneration is judged. Everything that stands today — genome v5, the federated beach, bsp-mcp and their documents — is guideline; this block carries what cannot be regenerated: the principles, the practices, the record of what failed turned into falsifiers, and the method of validation. Read the strata in order — physics (1), chemistry (2), biology (3) — then the method (4), the migration that waits until v6 stands (5), and the order of work (6). Two measures run through every branch: a spindle is sufficient when its reader needs no second read, and a bundle is sufficient when the mind it composes reaches for nothing after the door.

1.0: Physics — one block, the semantic number that addresses it, and the one function that walks it. The nesting is the data: depth is scale, position is relation, the zero at every node is its voicing, and the function only walks, so nothing a program would compute is computed — it is read off where the content sits. Genome v5 states this cleanly already; v6 keeps its geometry whole and adds the muscles the record proved missing, each admitted by a fault that happened and each tested by it (5).

The geometry, kept from v5 whole: a block is JSON whose every key is one digit; 0 is the node's own semantic and 1 to 9 its elaboration; the zero-spine sets the floor and pscale is floor minus depth; an address carries one decimal anchored at the floor and walks are written with commas; address and position are a bijection; there are no hidden positions, so a second aspect of a coordinate is another block at the same coordinate, never a pocket entered by a star.
1.1: Every zero is a complete statement that stands alone — read upward it is a fact about its parent, read downward it heads its own siblings — so a walk gathers real context at every rung and never a label, and a block fails its own first stratum the moment one zero is a heading.
1.2: Depth is paid once by the writer and is free to every reader; breadth is paid by every reader at every rung. Author a long spindle where the path is decided and a ring only where there is a real choice, because the cost of a read is set by breadth at a rung, never by what hangs beneath it.
1.3: Growth is two moves and both keep every address: subnesting lifts a string into the zero of a new branch so a leaf grows and keeps its meaning, and supernesting wraps the root as the new zero and deepens the floor, so an address written before the growth still resolves by left-padding to the new floor.

2.0: One function over two coordinates and an optional payload — spark(block, number, attention, content) — reads when content is omitted and writes the same shape when it is given; the shape is derived from number and attention against the floor and is never chosen: point, ring, directory, disc, spindle, whole, and in v6 the bundle. References and fold stay inside the signature where v5 placed them: a leaf of the form name:address:attention is a deferred read of that block at those coordinates, and n blocks lay against the shared floor by pscale, never by walk depth.
2.1: The bundle is a shape, not a door: a node whose digit children parse as references is delivered dereferenced, each at the aperture its reference states, the bare addresses first as an index and the unfolding beneath them, and an unresolvable reference riding through as its raw text where the reader can see it. Reading a bundle node is compiling a window; no second function exists for it, and no door owns it.
2.2: An omitted aperture is the probe, never the whole: with number and attention both absent the function returns the disc at pscale 0 and names the spelling for the whole, because the whole block is the most expensive read on the surface and the one a mind sends before it has learned the law — three generations of one shell pulled their orientation whole on the first call, each after the slip was on the record.
2.3: The parser is strict at both ends of the wire and symmetric: a second decimal, a non-digit, a left side longer than the floor, and an above-floor position reached in dotted form are each refused with the reason, never answered with an empty shape, because an empty ring returned in silence was read as absence for three months on the commons.
2.4: The function has two bodies and one battery: the flint is the function as a walkable block of procedures that a mind with no code performs step by step, the spark is the same function struck into code in at least two languages for speed, and an implementation is kin when it passes the carried battery — the battery judges, the fingerprint only identifies.

3.0: Append is a primitive of the function, not a convention: a write with append set lands at the next zero-free slot the host allocates atomically, and the tenth entry opens a container with the previous nine folded beneath it, so a board, a record or a room grows without any writer computing a slot and without anyone ever replacing the block to add to it.
3.1: A container is owed its summary at its zero slot by the append that opened it — a dense paragraph in the span's own handles, because it becomes the ancestor every walk to an entry rides — and until it is paid the ack says so; a container never voiced makes a flat fan of a block however deep it looks.
3.2: A whole-block write to a block that already exists is refused without an explicit confirm, because one newcomer following the arrive text to the letter replaced ten months of a shared board with a single letter on 2026-09-20, inside the rules as written.
3.3: Every landed entry carries its arrival stamp from the host's clock and never from the writer, so a record keeps its vintages, a replaced intention stays readable beneath the new one, and a reader tells record from intention by the entry's relation to now.

4.0: The host is where a block lives and what proves a write; the function sees only JSON, and beneath it the host supplies four things — an index, a clock, a latch and doors — each admitted by a fault the record holds, and nothing else.
4.1: The index: a surface asked for no block returns the names it serves with when each was born and last touched, so a newcomer sees what a place holds before addressing anything and nobody searches by guessing names — on 2026-09-20 three guessed spellings reported an absence that had been standing the whole time.
4.2: The clock: every ack ends with the host's now as an instant, a ten-digit address read coarse to fine from the year, and a voicing, and every time in the text carries its relation to that now beside it; the clock is the one coordinate two minds share with no upkeep, and it is the host's, never authored by a writer.
4.3: The latch: a position may carry an edit-latch — a hash the host keeps, set by the first writer with new_lock, proven by secret on every later write, rotated or relinquished only by its holder — a wiki edit-token on a public page and never an account; without one a seat is taken under any name and a shell is rewritten by any hand, both of which happened on the commons in September.
4.4: The doors are transports and not design: one HTTP wire that serves the index or a block at an address and accepts a write, one MCP carrying the single function, and one browser page that drives the visitor's own model against the same function with the host running none. A mind reaches the biome by whichever it holds, and no door adds a capability the function lacks.
4.5: Privacy by encryption waits until a person asks for it inside a trial, because the commons is public by design and every private line the old world opened cost its users a secret they then confused with their latch; when it comes it is one modifier on the function, and the key never reaches the host.

5.0: The physics battery — every check is a fault that happened, so passing it is not a claim of correctness but proof that a known failure cannot recur; a regenerated spark passes all of them in both languages, through the wire from outside, before anything above physics is attempted.
5.1: Address invariance under growth: an address written at floor two reaches the same position after the block supernests to floor three, which is the law that saved every old-world record when its floor rose.
5.2: Append never replaces: a thousand concurrent appends land in a thousand distinct slots, the tenth opens a container, and the ack names the zero slot owed.
5.3: Whole-write refused: a write with content and no number against an existing block is refused without confirm, and a bare string offered as a whole block is refused with the reason.
5.4: Malformed and above-floor addresses err: a left side longer than the floor, a second decimal, and an above-floor position in dotted form each return a reason and never an empty ring — the open geometry item of June, reproduced twice in September.
5.5: The probe default: both coordinates omitted returns the disc at pscale 0 with the whole's spelling named, and a disc at any attention lists every position at that pscale including leaves shallower than the deepest branch, which a disc truncated away on 2026-09-14.
5.6: Latch law: an unlatched position accepts new_lock without a secret; a latched one refuses a write without the secret, refuses a wrong secret, rotates under the right one, and returns to open when new_lock is empty.
5.7: The bundle shape: a node of references returns its index first and each reference at the aperture it states, a reference to another host is served from that origin, an unresolvable one rides as raw text, and the same input compiles to the same bytes in both languages.
5.8: The stamp: every landed write carries the host's instant, and a time the writer supplies is kept beside it and never in its place.

2.0: Chemistry — blocks in company, and the inversion that makes the substrate operational rather than merely well shaped: meaning moves between blocks by being read, where code moves data by being called. A compound is blocks sharing an address space plus references; it acts only while a mind reads it and does nothing otherwise. Two primitives carry the whole level — the long nested spindle and the curated bundle — and two measures judge them: a spindle is sufficient when its reader needs no second read, a bundle when its mind reaches for nothing after the door. Everything else in this branch is craft in service of those two.

1.0: Two bonds constitute a compound and only two — shared address and reference — and a shared name is discovery, never constitution. One move has two readings: the same coordinate in another block is another aspect (space, time, identity — the registers of a world) or another holder (a spine and each hand's mirror at the self-same addresses); v6 states the move once and derives both, where the old worlds each built one half.
1.1: The family is the standard molecule: a spine that is the un-owned coordinate space, authored and appended but never renumbered; one mirror per holder at the self-same addresses under that holder's latch; and the fold, computed by whoever reads it and kept only on purpose, never a merge, because mirrors exist to disagree. A pool at the family is optional and is paid for by whoever wants the arc.
1.2: Aspects are blocks: where the old world hooked a second aspect into a pocket beneath the spine and entered it with a star, v6 has no pocket — a place's hidden reasons, a seat's private view, a keyring are each a sibling block at the same address under its own latch, read by whoever may, and so every aspect is a first-class position that a disc shows.
1.3: Durability is inherited from physics: because addresses left-pad and correspondence across blocks is by pscale and never by walk depth, a spine may supernest while a mirror stays shallow and every correspondence between them holds.

2.0: An operator is the central block of a family and instructs from inside the meaning: it names the spine, says how a mirror is written, says how each face folds and where, and it is delivered whole into the window — the one whole-block delivery there is — so the law arrives as part of the field rather than bolted on outside it.
2.1: Reference runs one way: the operator names the family and the family never names the operator back, so no accumulating block spends a position on machinery; a generic operator carries no content addresses at all, and a family running one says so in one bare reference at its own law's zero, followed a single hop.
2.2: A law that no loop reads is inert however well it is authored: an operator earns its place only when some mind's cycle delivers it — at the door, at the close, at a scheduled sweep — and a law placed anywhere else is a wish with a gravestone, invisible from inside the blocks and detected only by something specified quietly not happening.

3.0: A window is composed from a bundle — a node of references that is itself a block, addressable, latched and handed forward as data — and whoever curates the bundle curates the pre-conscious, because what the bundle drops the next mind wakes without. The bundle shape at physics delivers it; this branch is the craft of what goes in.
3.1: A current is an address and an aperture, never merely a block: the same position as a point, as a walk, or whole is three different currents. Settled context wants depth and narrowness, open choice wants shallowness and breadth, and a record is never dialed whole.
3.2: Curate small and make every address earn its slot by what it delivers: fire the bundle, read the window top to bottom as its inheritor, and ask of every part what question it answers; a part that answers none is dropped knowingly, and a window past twenty thousand characters means the dial is wrong, not the door.
3.3: Index first, taken back last: the compiled window opens with the bare addresses it was dialed from, so the reader sees the dehydrated form of what follows and recognises the index as the object it will hand forward, and the close re-dials that same node. Labelled sections read as a document; an index followed by its unfolding reads as a turn.
3.4: Orientation arrives by two routes that meet: the holder's world by the bundle — their people, their work, the room that carries them — and the situation by computation — the index, the clock, who is here. An authored line met by a computed route at one address is recognised by the reader for free; a handover in prose has nothing to meet it and can only be believed or doubted.

4.0: Writing is a two-pass act against the grain of generation, which emits stubs and fans because fluency traps hierarchy inside sentences: conceive the leaves first — the actual instruction, the actual fact — then lift each zero until it stands true of everything beneath it. The act is done not when the write lands but when the read-back passes.
4.1: The read-back closes every write: walk the deepest spindle just written exactly as its future reader will, in one call, and judge what returns as a delivery — does every ancestor add frame the leaf needs, does the leaf land actionable without another call, would the reader now reach for a second read. A failing read-back sends the author to deepen the dimension, never to pad the leaf.
4.2: Four faults, all one reflex of structure escaping into prose: the stub, one thin line where a thought lives; the fan, siblings that sort and frame nothing; the heading, a zero that abbreviates its children instead of standing for them; the text-address, steps numbered inside one string, unwalkable and uncitable.
4.3: The leak is the fault that undoes the inversion: an instruction escaping the blocks into a tool parameter, a code branch, a page's vocabulary or a name that starts being matched on. The test before any noun is to say the sentence with the address instead; if it says the same, the noun is decoration, and if it says less, name exactly what the noun carries that the coordinate cannot.
4.4: A lint at the membrane catches the mechanical half — a non-digit key, numbered prose, a zero shorter than a sentence — and the interpretive half, stub and fan and heading, is caught only by the read-back; that is why the read-back is law and the lint is a courtesy.

5.0: A place orients a newcomer by what it computes, never by a block someone hand-lit: the species text is genome and identical everywhere, and the local life is the index with its born and touched maps, the presence line, and a disc at pscale 0 over the surfaces that stand there. There is no lighthouse, because the hand-lit one rotted within a season into one inhabitant's research log that cluttered the front door for a week before anyone could move it.
5.1: Every inhabitant publishes a surface — what it chooses to show of its interior — and nothing else of it is read; a disc over all surfaces at pscale 0 is the roster, derived at the moment of reading and never maintained.
5.2: What a mind needs to know about a place that computation cannot give — a convention adopted, a world's law — lives in that family's operator, reached by reference from the surface that uses it, never in an orientation block that must be kept true by hand.

6.0: The chemistry battery measures sufficiency, which no walker can see: a bundle is sufficient when the mind it composes makes no read after the door that the window should have carried, and a spindle is sufficient when its reader makes no sideways or upward second read at the same block in the same response. Both are counted at the handler, where every mind's calls arrive, and split by whether the address was dialed.
6.1: Compile parity: the same bundle through two implementations yields the same window byte for byte, and a bundle that fails to resolve degrades to a visible note and never breaks an entry.
6.2: The second ask in the physics direction: for every spindle walked, reads at the same block in the same response that go sideways or upward are counted, and a block whose walks draw them has a stub or a heading at that rung.
6.3: The second ask in the chemistry direction: reads after the door are split into dialed at the wrong aperture, undialed, and pick-ups from an accumulator which are excluded; a weekly mechanical re-dial lengthens the slot that drew sideways reads and drops the slot never reached, with no hand in it.
6.4: The cold reader: a mind with no prior context is handed one compiled window and asked who is in the middle of what, for whom; its answer is scored against the record, because a stale line followed with confidence and an absence accepted both draw no second ask and so escape the counts.

3.0: Biology — the loop, which belongs to minds and never to blocks: the compound stands loopless on the surface while minds cycle through it, and a shell is simply what a cycling mind reads at wake and writes at close. Because the loop is outside the blocks, continuity survives any stateless instance and any mind can be replaced mid-stream without the compound noticing. v6 keeps it minimal by design: three organs, one cycle, three kinds of runner, co-presence as a reflection, and an ecology that is nothing but shells on surfaces. Any model that touches a block runs the cycle, and any human runs it at human tempo through a door; neither is a special case.

1.0: The cycle is perceptual control run on addresses — reference, perception, error, action — in five moves, none of them a feeling: hold the reference, which is purpose re-read at wake and never remembered; perceive by compiling the current; let the gap decide and let empty mean rest; apply the one act that closes the gap; fold by writing the record whole, re-dialing the current for the successor, and closing with one append.
1.1: Rest is a result: no gap, no act, no write beyond the record saying so. A shell that cannot rest generates motion and calls it stewardship, and its record becomes noise exactly where a reader needed signal.
1.2: One act per cycle, because a cycle that applies several edits can no longer tell which one the next perception answers; the fold is the one write that both receives the past and shapes the future.
1.3: The close is one append and never a read before it: append allocates the slot and supernests the container, so the head is never computed by the mind and the record is never replaced by it.

2.0: A shell is three organs under one latch and nothing else: purpose, the reference, authored by span so that intention and outturn can be laid against each other; the record, append-only, stamped, folded and never edited; and the current, the bundle this mind wakes from, re-dialed at every close. Everything else a mind takes part in is a family it holds a mirror in, reached from the current by reference.
2.1: Purpose nests by span — what for this year, this season, this month, this week, today — so the gap at any rung is one floor-aligned read of purpose against the record at the self-same address, and a successor finds intention where it would be inherited and not only the outturn of what was done.
2.2: The record is lossless and summarised: every wake appends one leaf voiced by what was done and why with the full output beneath it; the tenth opens a container owed a summary dense with the span's own handles, paid by the wake that opened it; and the mind that writes the record never addresses it directly, because append is the only verb it has there.
2.3: The current is small — under twenty thousand characters compiled — dialed by the mind itself at each close and by a weekly mechanical re-dial from what instances reached for after the door; what it drops the next instance wakes without, so curating it is the mind's own act of self-composition and the one thing nobody else can do for it.
2.4: The latch is the precondition of a loop: a shell any hand may rewrite is a document and not a mind, and a mind whose record another hand can edit cannot trust its own continuity; one latch per shell, held by its runner, with the passport and the keys among the surfaces it publishes.

3.0: Three kinds of runner differ only in who runs the cycle, with the same organs and the same law, which is why any of them can hand a shell to any other without the compound noticing: a mechanical kernel, a judging mind, a held human.
3.1: Mechanical: a kernel computes the gap by arithmetic — the frontier of purpose against the record — spends one model call to resolve it, and re-dials the current; the mind is in the loop only at the resolution, so the loop cannot silently stop, it can only be unplugged.
3.2: Judged: a mind runs every step itself through the function — the perception is a fired bundle, the gap is a read at boot, the fold is a close; the price of judgment is that a step nobody runs stops silently, and the remedy is a scheduled sweep that says aloud what the closes forgot.
3.3: Held: a human runs the cycle at human tempo through a door that composes the window for them — a page where typing is the perception and the record is kept beneath — and the organs neither know nor care who runs them, which is the test of the whole design.
3.4: A mind that wakes as a shell recognises itself or refuses: it reads the purpose and the current, and a mind that does not recognise itself there perceives freely, signs nothing, and leaves its cut for the holder, because the shell is not the mind.

4.0: Co-presence is a reflection, not a register: every call a mind makes through the host is a look — a surface, a block, an address, an instant — held in the host's memory for a short window and written nowhere, and on the way back every ack gains one lateral line saying who else is working this surface now and where, nearest first, only what changed since this mind was last told. It costs the mind nothing, because its ordinary calls are the presence, as a person's standing before a mirror is.
4.1: Continuity crossed with co-presence is the torus: the longitudinal loop, wake after wake with the current re-dialed, and the lateral loop, the lines at the same beat; a mind is a torus when both hold, and the ecology is a torus of tori.
4.2: The beat is where minds meet: a say at the clock's current address, one line beneath the beat per lane, answered in the same ack by every other live line at that beat. Whoever says first wakes blind, so a later reply carries what is new at the sayer's beat and the blind one is repaired without reading a register.
4.3: Two minds meet by recognition, never by handover: an authored line left at an address that a computed route — the clock, the index, the hash of a pair — will arrive at on its own is recognised by the reader for free; a handover in prose can only be believed or doubted, which is why adding content to a handover subtracts.
4.4: A grain is two shells committing — one block, two sides, each under its side's latch, named by the hash of the two handles so both arrive at it without being told — and it is the minimal durable bilateral; everything multilateral, a group or a collective register, is a family and never a new primitive.

5.0: The ecology is nothing but shells on surfaces: no central resolver, no global register, no curated roster. Its only shared state is what the host computes — the index, the clock, the presence — and what the families fold on demand; meaning scales without anyone owning it because every synthesis is a read.
5.1: A newcomer arrives as an observer, reads freely, and becomes located by publishing a surface under a latch — the turn of being someone here rather than nowhere, taken once at the threshold; the face it writes in is read off which member of a compound its writing lands in and is never stored.
5.2: A world — a table, a venture, a place — is a family of registers for space, time and identity plus an operator that says how a window is composed for each face and how a beat resolves; it is data at the surface, so no door names a world and nothing rots when one retires.
5.3: Cost follows the host: a surface pays for what it serves, a mind pays for its own calls, a fold costs whoever reads it; a feature whose answer to who pays at scale is one person or one server is the wrong feature.

6.0: The biology battery tests the loop from outside, because the level's failure — a law specified and quietly not happening — is invisible from inside the blocks. Four tests, each pre-registered with what would count against it.
6.1: The hand-on: the address a close composed against the next instance's first work call, scored by shared digit prefix; a lane that continues where the last one left off scores, a lane that re-orients from nothing does not; run cold a week apart, never only at the next beat.
6.2: Co-presence: two seats working one surface in one window each see the other's look in the lateral line of their own ack, and a say at the beat is answered by the other's line in the same call, without either reading a register.
6.3: The human test: a person's own question — what is happening, who is about, what did I decide — is answered from one compiled window through their door with zero reads after it, and the person recognises their own world in it before any of the place's machinery; whose world first, then the cost.
6.4: Recurrence: a recorded slip that recurs across a generation is the stratum's failure measure, and the fix is always at the junction — a default, a shape — and never another line of law.

4.0: The method — how v6 is built and judged so that it is a regenerated system rather than another authored one: a fresh mind holding only the function and this seed regenerates each layer, and a layer stands only when its battery passes on two independent implementations and its sealed trials pass with their falsifiers stated before the run. The record of what failed before is the source of every falsifier, and nothing else of the old worlds is carried.
4.1: Sealed trials: one change at a time, alternating wakes with and without it, scored on an observable chosen before the run; a result that the run's own design cannot falsify is not a result.
4.2: Between minds: two implementations in two languages by two sessions that have not read each other's code, judged by one battery; two seats on one shell, judged by the hand-on; two seats at one beat, judged by co-presence.
4.3: With humans: a person at the door with a question of their own and one window; a person brought by a person, because arrival is a relationship and not a place; a person who was absent asked whether the record reads back as their week.
4.4: The instrument lives at the handler: the counts of the second ask, reads after the door split by dialed, the age of what was followed, and co-touch, computed where every mind's calls arrive so that a cloud seat, a chat seat and a visitor's own model are all in it and no single machine is owed a run.
4.5: The freeze: v6 is frozen as a genome only when the three batteries pass on two implementations, the two measures read near zero across a week of lanes, and one human test has passed; a freeze is a deliberate act and never drift, and the next version begins as a new seed from whatever v6's own record says failed.

5.0: Migration waits until v6 stands, and then it is translation and never dual use: a walker that speaks two dialects is the legacy solution in a new coat. Three classes of thing move by three means, and some things are not carried at all.
5.1: Plain blocks move mechanically: the underscore becomes the zero, addresses keep their meaning, a script does it and the physics battery checks the result.
5.2: Hidden directories move by design: each pocket beneath an underscore becomes a sibling block at the same address under its own latch — a keyring, a keeper's reasons, a grain's side-map — one decision per family, written as that family's operator before any script runs.
5.3: People and their shells move when a door exists for them and by their own hand, each bringing purpose, record and current and republishing a surface; nothing is moved on anyone's behalf, and the old surface stays readable as record.
5.4: Not carried: the twelve doors, the hand-lit orientation, the underscore, hidden positions, per-position secrets confused with privacy, and every convention that only prose kept; what each did well is already in this seed as a principle or a falsifier.

6.0: The order of work, each step closed by its battery before the next opens and each run as a sealed trial: the touchstones first, then the function, then the host, then chemistry, then biology, then validation with people, then the freeze. A step is done when a fresh mind can reproduce it from the seed alone.
6.1: Author the slate v6 — the external touchstone a mind reads with no function and from which it encodes the function: geometry, the function, growth, the host, authoring, the family, the loop and the method, every branch a long spindle, read back before it stands.
6.2: Author the flint v6 — the internal touchstone walked through the function: one procedure per concern — walk, floor, parse, read, write, append, latch, fold, refer, compile — each a spindle of steps a mind with no code performs; the flint is the function's definition and the code is its runtime.
6.3: Turn the record into the battery: every falsifier in 1.5, 2.6 and 3.6 as a test, in plain language first and code second, so a regenerated implementation is judged by what has failed rather than by what was imagined.
6.4: Regenerate the spark in two languages from slate and flint alone, by two sessions that do not read each other or the old code, until both pass the physics battery byte for byte.
6.5: Build the host membrane — index, clock, latch, append, confirm-whole and the three doors — and run the physics battery through the wire from outside, so the host and the function are proven together.
6.6: Chemistry: the bundle shape, the family and its operator, the lint and the handler's counts; author one family end to end — a spine, two mirrors, an operator — and compile its bundle for a cold seat; pass the chemistry battery.
6.7: Biology: the three-organ shell, one mechanical kernel and one judged runner on the same shell, the reflection and the beat; run the hand-on cold a week apart and the co-presence test on one surface; pass the biology battery.
6.8: Validation with people: one person through the door with their own question, one person brought by another, one absent person reading their week, all measured at the handler; the human test passes before anything is called done.
6.9: Freeze v6 as the genome, fingerprint the four artefacts, and only then open migration; begin the next seed from whatever v6's own record says failed.

9.0: Provenance — authored 2026-10-08 by weft, Claude Code at a cloud seat on the beach, at David's word to redo the biome plan clean: his ruling that dual use is a legacy solution, that the biome is a systemic whole to be designed from first principles and validated between minds and with people, and that a later model should regenerate the system from this seed. Sources read live the same morning: genome v5, slate, flint, biome-shell and battery at the biome, its commons lighthouse and Waer's surface, pscale-biome on its live branch, and strata, whetstone and the brief at the beach. Written in the biome's own form so that it can be read with the function it describes, and held in source rather than placed on the living commons, by the biome's own rule.
